name: Utilities split
summary: Split a month's utility bills between roommates, shift one person's overage onto them, and track who has been asked and who has paid.
useWhen: roommates splitting electric, wifi, water and gas for a month, one person fronted it
'Theo ran the AC all month', 'utilities are in, I'll request everyone'
dontUseWhen: many IOUs between many people (use settle-up)
